source: van de Plassche et al., Phys. Plasmas 27, 022310 (2020)
description: Accuracy and dataset figures printed in van de Plassche et al. (2020) for the QLKNN-10D networks (read in arXiv:1911.05617).
notes: Only printed values are kept. Table IV gives the RMS test error in gyro-Bohm units, on the unstable 9D test set with values above 33 filtered out, for the three leading flux networks. The paper prints no percentage RMSE, no R^2 and no particle-flux RMSE; the earlier rmse_pct and r2 entries (4.8/6.2/8.1 %, 0.97/0.95/0.92 for efi/efe/pfe) had no source and were removed.

training_details.training_samples: 3 x 10^8 QuaLiKiz flux calculations (Table I; abstract: 300 million)
training_details.input_space_note: The nine inputs of Table I. Rotation is handled by a separate post-processing rule (section III); there is no alpha input.
training_details.speedup: 3 to 5 orders of magnitude faster than JINTRAC-QuaLiKiz (abstract)
